decisions.required_owner_action: Provide the owner-approved project LICENSE or EULA and record the governing distribution terms as evidence.
Record and evidence the distribution basis for PyQt6 and PyQt6-WebEngine without assuming a commercial entitlement or a GPL-compatible project license.
Record and evidence the distribution basis for Qt and Qt WebEngine, including the Chromium components shipped in the frozen application.
Provide and evidence a deterministic notice and license payload for every component in each portable and installer distribution channel.
Record and evidence how applicable corresponding-source, replacement or relinking, installation-information, and reverse-engineering rights are delivered.

Record whether Inno Setup is used in a commercial context and, if applicable, record the owner-approved commercial-license decision or entitlement instead of assuming one from the local compiler installation.
